programs.desc: Rene shows up to West Covina feeling very nostalgic; Kenny zeroes in on a tricycle locker and deals with what's inside; the Calvins just try to have a fun day, while Barry can't understand the general lack of professionalism among his peers.

programs.title: Storage Wars

programs.desc: The Lord of Lancaster tries to levy tariffs on his visitors, but Dusty & Lupe manage to distract him long enough to cut out a profit; Dave is finally able to see the light. Kenny's new friends fit him like a glove.
